finalReview.productManagerStatement: Accepted. The Codex CCG provider execution chain is repaired end to end and every PRD acceptance criterion is backed by code in this snapshot. The pinned codeagent-wrapper is now installed and owned by Codex mode at <CODEX_HOME>/ccg/bin/, reusing the existing verified-binary installer instead of a second downloader, and the legacy ~/.claude/bin copy is left alone. A new narrow `ccg wrapper` command resolves that managed binary, re-checks its ownership digest and pinned version on every call, refuses ordinary Claude delegation, spawns with an argv array and shell:false, and never injects --lite — so Antigravity still opens its loopback Web UI by default. Role routing now enforces the exact capability matrix you specified (frontend/backend: codex, gemini, antigravity, grok, pi; search: codex, grok; product-manager: codex, gemini, claude) and fails closed with the role and allowed providers rather than silently falling back or rewriting your config. Codex doctor is route-aware: it fails on missing or corrupt managed wrapper, unavailable selected provider CLIs, and unavailable product-manager runtimes, and points only at Codex-mode install/recover or a precise `ccg routing set` command. Release artifacts are coupled and consistent at 3.4.6 with the Harness snapshot pinned to the approved personal-source commit, and the sparse-path defect was fixed at the shared materializer root with path/blob/mode tests. Offline E2E proves the Antigravity 127.0.0.1 Web UI URL and browser opener, Grok resume, Pi, --parallel, and a clean home that never touches .claude. Verification is green: 452 passing tests with zero failures, zero security findings, zero blocking conflicts, and green CI on PR #31 and post-merge main. Two residuals are disclosed rather than hidden: the real Pi live smoke was never run (it is an explicit human-authorization gate you deliberately excluded from completion), and three tests skip on this Windows host because of a POSIX permission mode and symlink privilege limits — those same cases pass in Linux CI. The earlier FINAL rejection was a request to re-run this Claude review, not a product objection, and nothing in the deliverable required rework. Recommend closing the task with those two residuals noted.

Do not schedule further implementation work under this task; if a live Pi smoke is desired, raise it as a separately authorized verification action.

pmReview.productManagerStatement: 你要的「修复 Codex CCG Provider 运行链」已经在快照中真实落地，可以验收。核心链路四件事都能在代码里逐条对上：一是 Codex 模式现在会把 codeagent-wrapper 作为受管理文件装到 <CODEX_HOME>/ccg/bin/ 下，纳入 ownership 与事务，复用原有的固定摘要下载器而不是另起一套；二是新增了 ccg wrapper 稳定入口，强制单一显式 --backend、拒绝 claude、调用前校验摘要与版本、以参数数组安全 spawn，默认不注入 --lite，因此 Antigravity 会照常自动开 127.0.0.1 的 Web UI 并拉起浏览器；三是路由改为静态能力矩阵，product-manager 仍然只允许 codex/gemini/claude，不兼容组合直接失败并告知允许项，不再静默回退；四是 doctor 变成路由感知，wrapper 缺失或损坏、选中 Provider 的 CLI 不在 PATH 时都会判失败并给出 codex-mode 的修复命令，不会再假装全绿。发布侧也已闭环：版本 3.4.6，个人源 commit/tree 与 harness.sources.json 一一对应，PR #31 已合并且 CI 全通过，本机已装上 3.4.6 运行时并连续 3 次 doctor 通过；离线 E2E 用假的 agy/grok/pi 覆盖了 Web UI、resume、parallel 和 clean-home 不产生 .claude。上一轮 M1 被拒的理由是「Claude 产品经理服务可用，请重新来一遍」，属于复核流程要求，本轮已由本机 Claude 完成复核，未发现新的产品缺陷。唯一保留项是 Pi 的真实调用 smoke 没做——这本来就写在 PRD 的不在范围内、需要你单独授权才会碰真实登录和付费调用，所以不影响本次验收；另外文档里 wrapper 版本还写着 5.12.3，代码里已是 5.12.5，建议顺手改掉。
